design: Round 1 (12 queries): measure E1 ranks 1-8 (top finalists) plus 4 stratified controls at E1 ranks 150, 226, 400, 800 to test the monotone enrichment of measured GRWT100 with E1 rank and to bracket the measured 75th-percentile boundary. Round 2 (18 queries): measure E1 ranks 9-26 to extend the measured finalist pool; then re-rank all phenotyped lines by measured GRWT100 (E3), tie-break by E1, and fill any remaining slots of the final top-10 with the highest E1-predicted unmeasured lines.
observation_metric: Measured GRWT100 (g/100 grains) per queried line; metrics = Spearman(E1 rank, E3 value) over phenotyped lines, mean measured value of E1 top-8 vs stratified controls, and hit rate of E1-top lines above the bracketed 75th-percentile boundary of the candidate distribution.
refutation_condition: H1 refuted if Spearman(E1 rank, E3 measured) <= 0 over phenotyped lines OR the mean measured GRWT100 of the E1 top-8 is not higher than the stratified control mean (i.e. no enrichment).
